column5: THE FIGMA DETAIL PAGE IS ENTIRELY UNBUILT. There is no /play/hilo route in src/App.tsx - dice, crash, mines, plinko, blackjack, coinflip, scratchers, price-grid and poker all have one - so Hi-Lo exists only as a modal off /originals, and 9061-10499 Hi-Lo Start (1440x3294), 9061-9472 Hi-Lo Loss and 9351-4708 (375x812, mis-titled 'Blackjack') have no implementation at all. Read against 9061-10499, the bet panel it specifies is Bet / SKIP CARD / Higher-or-Same 30.77% / Lower-or-Same 76.92% / Potential profit, with ghost 'King/Queen The Highest' and 'Ace Being The Lowest' cards flanking the live card, split Profit(High) and Profit(Low) fields, and a drawn-cards strip below. HiLoGame.tsx implements NONE of Skip Card, the ghost cards, the split profit fields or the drawn-cards strip, and it adds a 7777 JACKPOT toggle (JACKPOT_NUMBER, line 119) that appears in no frame. ★ CATALOG DEFECT - HALF THIS SECTION IS NOT HI-LO: 9058-1833 'Desktop' renders a 3x3 match-3 symbol grid with a 'Match 3 to Win!' 1.98x paytable and 9058-2367 'Card out' is a generic Manual/Auto bet panel; both are SCRATCHERS, consistent with 9058-4372 and 9058-5154 whose own titles read 'Skai > Play > Casino > Scratchers'. 9079-3253, 9332-27318 and 9332-27319 are pasted screenshots/photos. The real Hi-Lo surface here is roughly 4 frames, not 12, and the section wants re-cutting before its counts mean anything. ★ FIGMA FRAME BUG STANDS: for identical stated odds (Higher-or-Same 30.77%, Lower-or-Same 76.92%) the Start frame shows Higher 1.17x / Lower 4.29x while the Loss frame shows 3.22x / 1.29x. Only Loss is arithmetically consistent (0.99/0.3077 = 3.22); Start is INVERTED and would be house-negative if built as drawn. Start also carries a 'Practice mode off' toggle that will never be built. ★ ECONOMICS (correction of an older note retracted 2026-07-29): the admin key hilo_house_edge stores a FRACTION (default 0.01) and the client reads it as one, so client = 99/wc and the live POINTS rail points-game:5313 is also 99/wc - they AGREE at 1% and there is no player-visible discrepancy today. The dormant money rail game-settlement:3957 uses 95/wc, so enabling REAL_MONEY_PLAY_ENABLED would cut Hi-Lo payouts 4.21%. Hi-Lo therefore runs 1% while Dice, Mines, Chicken and Crash run higher - a product inconsistency to decide, not a bug. 0 of 12 frames ever visually verified.
